Name: Eta's Wizard Furniture recolour
Author: EtaMyosotis
Description:
[size=3]Because the original wizard furniture was a bit too saturated in colour and it was hard to match the rest of my furniture, so I recoloured it.

Reduced saturation for better eye friendliness. 
I also made a version that turned the purple carpet blue and darkened the colour of the blue crystal ball. Since I like dark blue, this was customised specifically for myself. But just in case anyone else likes it, I'll put it in the optional file. 
To match this version, I've also recoloured that fabulous purple wallpaper.  Also placed within the optional file.

[b]Note: The main file and the version that modifies the carpet colour are in conflict, just install one of them.[/b]

I didn't encounter any problems in my testing. If there are bugs, please let me know![/size]
